newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA OPT FOR EXTRA BATTING PRACTICE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA OPT FOR EXTRA BATTING PRACTICE.

text.p: India's cricketers have agreed to play Natal in a limited overs match on Monday in an attempt to improve their woeful batting.
Indian captain Sachin Tendulkar, reeling from Saturday's crushing defeat by South Africa, said: "We really batted badly in the test and this department clearly has to improve.

"Monday's 50-overs-a-side match against Natal should help our batsmen with much-needed time in the middle. This match is obviously a practice match for us and, although it's a one-day game, it's the atmosphere which is important.
"It's just the feeling of our batsmen being there in the middle that's required."
